01

In the Age of AI, the Future Needs Humans. But For What?

For professionals, educators and leaders asking where human value belongs when machines can generate more of the output. We explore problem framing, verification and responsibility through relatable workplace decisions.

02

Before the AI Agent: Fix the Business Process

For business owners and product teams. A practical conversation about turning scattered requests into clear workflows, then choosing where AI can help.

03

Building AI for the Africa We Actually Live In

For builders and organisations. How to account for connectivity, local language, user confidence and safe fallback when designing technology people will depend on.

What I bring to the room

Clear explanations, practical questions and a respect for the people who will use the technology. These are proposed talk topics; format and scope can be shaped around your audience.

In your invitation, tell me who will attend, what they are struggling with, the date, location or virtual format, and the outcome you want them to leave with.
